BORDERLANDS ONLINE - XBOX CONTROLLER MOD

INSTALL
1. Download XboxControllerMod-1.0.zip from the GitHub release.
2. Right-click the ZIP, choose Properties, and select Unblock if shown.
   Click Apply, then extract the ZIP into its own folder.
3. Close Borderlands Online and connect your Xbox/XInput controller.
4. Open the extracted folder in Terminal and run:

   powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\install.ps1 -GameDirectory "C:\Path\To\Game"

   Replace C:\Path\To\Game with the folder containing BOL.exe.
5. Launch the game. Release the sticks, triggers and buttons to activate.

PLAY
Left stick: move. Right stick: look. RT: shoot. LT: aim.
A: jump. B: crouch. X: interact with a target, otherwise reload.
Y: change weapon. LB: skill. RB: grenade.
Left stick click: sprint. Right stick click: melee.
D-pad: weapon slots. View/Back: inventory. Menu/Start: pause/back.

MENUS AND INVENTORY
Move the cursor with the left stick; use the right stick for precision.
A clicks; hold A to drag items. X opens item menus. B goes back.
LT/RT scroll. Hold LB for Shift. RB moves to the next text field.
Click a text field, then Y to open the keyboard. D-pad selects a key,
A types, X deletes, LB toggles Shift, Start submits, and B/Y closes.

SETTINGS
Press F10 or hold View/Back + Menu/Start for half a second.
Adjust sensitivity and deadzones, rebind buttons, then click Save.
The Game menus tab opens skills, quests, maps, chat and other menus.
If controller input is disabled, use F10 to enable it again.

REMOVE
Close the game. In the extracted mod folder run:
   powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\uninstall.ps1
Keep this folder: it contains your installation record and backups.

NOTES
Requires the compatible Windows Unity 4.6 Borderlands Online client.
This is an initial preview: automated checks pass; Xbox hardware and
individual menus still need an in-game check. Movement uses the game's
eight directions; camera and cursor input are analog. Menus use a cursor.
If the controller is unresponsive, focus the game window and release all
controls, then check the controller slot in F10 settings. If you use a
separate controller-to-keyboard mapper, disable its game profile to avoid
duplicate input. Installation does not require the Creative mod.
